_comment: Every PDK the composed image ships, where it comes from, and where its version can be READ BACK OUT OF THE IMAGE. vibeic-eda#28. A PDK is not a lesser dependency here: open_pdks produces the libs.tech trees every DRC and LVS verdict is computed against, so a change there moves sign-off results the way a change in klayout's LEF/DEF importer does — which is exactly what #17 turned out to be. Nothing in this repository named these before; the versions were legible only inside the image, and only for some of them.
_status_field: status describes what the IMAGE does: ours = we build/stage it ourselves; upstream = the base image's copy is what ships. `mirror` is a separate fact — vibeic-eda#30 mirrored the three PDK sources so the daily upstream check can watch them, and that does NOT by itself change which copy the image uses. Collapsing the two would make this file say the image builds a PDK it does not.

pdks.name: sky130A
pdks.read_by: every sky130 DRC and LVS run, via libs.tech
pdks.upstream_note: moved org AND renamed (underscore to hyphen); RTimothyEdwards/open_pdks is the old name

pdks.name: gf180mcuD
pdks.read_by: every gf180 DRC and LVS run, via libs.tech

pdks.name: ihp-sg13g2
pdks.arrives: staged by our Dockerfile (tools/ihp-open-pdk/) from the vibeic/IHP-Open-PDK mirror, pinned by IHP_OPEN_PDK_REF -- moved off the base image by vibeic-eda#60 so a patch of ours to a tech file or device model has somewhere to go

pdks.name: ciel
pdks.read_by: PDK fetch/versioning; not itself a sign-off input

pdks.name: asap7
pdks.arrives: staged by our Dockerfile from FOUR vibeic mirrors: OpenROAD-flow-scripts (ARG OPENROAD_FLOW_SCRIPTS_REF = 66f174f8e14f7cdd178a1e1d37c915d28ac3e24d, the v3.0 tag through image 0.2.51) supplies the physical enablement — 5 RVT/TT Liberty + tech LEF + cell LEF + GDS + KLayout DRC + OpenRCX rules, 11 of the 20 files — and asap7sc7p5t_28 / asap7_pdk_r1p7 / ASAP7_for_KLayout (ARG ASAP7SC_REF / ASAP7PDK_REF / ASAP7KL_REF) supply the device-LVS source-of-truth, the other 9.

pdks.name: nangate45
pdks.arrives: staged by our Dockerfile from the vibeic ORFS mirror, pinned by ARG OPENROAD_FLOW_SCRIPTS_REF (66f174f8e14f7cdd178a1e1d37c915d28ac3e24d = upstream master at 2026-08-01, mirrored as branch vibeic-orfs-pin-20260801; the ARG was ORFS_REF holding the v3.0 tag through image 0.2.51). All six staged files are byte-identical across that move.
pdks.read_by: the nangate45 flow (FreePDK45, educational DRC only)
